propertyType: Entire serviced apartment in Candolim, India

highlights.description: The pool and alfresco dining are great for summer trips.

highlights.title: Designed for staying cool

description: 🌴 Plan Your Relaxing Holiday at Amor De Goa by Mirashya Homes! ✨ Stay in this cozy 1BHK in the heart of Candolim, featuring a private jacuzzi 🛁 for the perfect unwind. Enjoy high-speed WiFi 💻, Smart TV 📺, pet-friendly comfort 🐾, and stylish interiors. Just minutes from Candolim Beach 🏖️, popular cafés, restaurants, and nightlife 🍹, it's ideal for couples seeking romance, relaxation, and a touch of luxury in North Goa. ❤️🌴

reviews.author: Priya
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning property! The jacuzzi was a dream and the space was spotlessly clean. Would love to come back.

reviews.author: Rahul
reviews.text: Perfect Goa staycation. Loved the vibe of the lower-ground lounge. Host was super responsive.

reviews.author: Sneha
reviews.text: Loved every bit of it! The pool, the gym, and the bedroom were all immaculate. Highly recommend.

location.description: Candolim is a laid-back beach village on the north Goa coast, known for its clean beaches, water sports, and vibrant shacks. The property is a short drive from Sinquerim and Calangute.

cancellationPolicy: Moderate – Full refund for cancellations made 5 days before check-in.
